mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.part_id, l.level_order, l.title, l.description, l.question_type, l.question_count, l.pair_count, l.card_ids, l.status, l.created_time, l.updated_time FROM NC.study_level l WHERE l.part_id = #{partId} ORDER BY l.level_order, l.id

SELECT l.id, l.part_id, l.level_order, l.title, l.description, l.question_type, l.question_count, l.pair_count, l.card_ids, l.status, l.created_time, l.updated_time FROM NC.study_level l WHERE l.part_id = #{partId} AND l.status = 1 ORDER BY l.level_order, l.id

SELECT l.id, l.part_id, l.level_order, l.title, l.description, l.question_type, l.question_count, l.pair_count, l.card_ids, l.status, l.created_time, l.updated_time FROM NC.study_level l INNER JOIN NC.study_part p ON p.id = l.part_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND p.dialect = #{dialect}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.study_level (part_id, level_order, title, description, question_type, question_count, pair_count, card_ids, status) VALUES (#{partId}, #{levelOrder}, #{title}, #{description}, #{questionType}, #{questionCount}, #{pairCount}, #{cardIds}, #{status})
